findings.title: New comment misstates how stop_send_loop() waits on the queue future
findings.claim: The comment says nothing else waits for _outgoing_queue_ready and that stop_send_loop() only waits for _sink_closed_future, but stop_send_loop() at rpc.cc:225 actually waits on both futures via when_all; the comment omits that std::exchange leaves an already-ready queue future so the wait doesn't double-consume it.

findings.title: server_factory registered in hook_capturing_compressor_factory but its hooks are never…
findings.claim: The test scaffolding registers a server_factory whose hooks are never exercised or checked.

findings.title: Unused is_server parameter and const_cast mutation of hooks in a const method
findings.claim: The is_server parameter is unused, and mutating hooks via const_cast inside a const method is a code smell.

findings.title: compress() has an unexplained special case for empty data
findings.claim: compress() uses data.size ? std::move(data) : rpc::snd_buf(temporary_buffer<char>()), an odd special case with no explanation.

findings.title: test_stream_send_after_stream_close cannot distinguish 'refused' from 'never reached'
findings.claim: The try/catch swallows closed_error and accepts a successful send, with the only real assertion being !st.put_after_close; the test never asserts the hook call actually threw closed_error, so a regression where send() accepts the frame without reaching put() would still pass.

findings.title: _stream_closing set before write buffer is touched
findings.claim: Reviewer checked and confirms _stream_closing is set before the write buffer is touched, which is correct.

findings.title: Drain ignores exceptions and still closes the buffer
findings.claim: Reviewer checked and confirms the drain ignores exceptions and still closes the buffer, which is correct.

findings.title: _error left alone as PR description explains
findings.claim: Reviewer checked and confirms _error is intentionally left alone, matching the PR description.

findings.title: eof marker from sink_impl::close() awaited before close_sink(), not lost
findings.claim: Reviewer checked and confirms the eof marker is awaited before close_sink() so it is not lost.

findings.title: Doc/header comments match code regarding sole caller of close_source()
findings.claim: Reviewer checked and confirms the doc and header comments match the code: source_impl::operator() is the only caller of close_source().
